$Comment: A normal daily: Void essence found at a Disenchanting Table. STATION_OUTPUT on the exact essence id, qualified to the tables, so void from an Outlander's pocket does not count; the table finds it only in gear of iron grade and up, so this contract rewards a worker feeding the table real gear. Weight 1 keeps it an even draw against its rivals for the normal slot. Qualifier 'Disenchanting_Table' with QualifierMatchMode PREFIX counts both tables and never the Sawmill. This file spells out its whole step and pay rather than inheriting a shared skeleton, so it loads with nothing but this pack, RPG Stations and the MMO installed; it hangs on the Daily board by id, and on a server with no board of that id it is simply never posted. The stations feature gate in Requires is for a server where stations have been switched off: a board draws its slots without reading a contract's Requires, so the gate refuses at Accept rather than keeping the contract off the board.
